sections.appearance: She has violet long hair reaching her legs tied at the end with a similar cybernetic wing on her halo. She has violet eyes. Halo ==== Utaha's halo has a pink digital-framed hexagon with a similar designed rhombus inside. Also her halo has a cybernetic wing on each sides. Uniform ==== She wears a shiny lab coat and a standard uniform, including a black sweater clipped with a Millennium access badge, a white shirt and blue tie underneath and a pleated white skirt. She wears black tights and black uwabaki. Firearm ==== thumb|Meister Zero She uses a white Ingram MAC-11 submachine gun with a magenta magazine. Though she never uses it for combat. thumb|Ikazuchi-chan For most of her combat deployment she entirely relies on "Ikazuchi-chan" (雷ちゃん). A white turret with two six-barreled rotary guns. The Millennium insignia is imprinted on the turret body presumably where the ammunition or power battery is stored. She also relies on the smaller version of Ikazuchi-chan called "Ikazuchi-chan MK-II" (雷ちゃんMK-Ⅱ).

sections.personality: Just like her fellow Engineering Department members, she has an affinity towards inventing and the like. Though she may be a genius, she can sometimes misunderstand relatively simple things, such as how she thinks that real animals are highly intelligent robots. She also likes to add unnecessary additions to her inventions, similar to her other club members. What made Utaha different compared to other Engineering Department members is that she is a strict perfectionist, and hate anything that flawed, from an already stellar enough creations that have tiny and somehow irrelevant "flaw", into even letting herself look vulnerable, which is why she don't want anyone to watch her doing stuff. According to her MomoTalk chat, she has already dabbled in engineering since she was young, and thus have a dirty, cracked, and calloused hands. Her hands that doesn't look flawless is the reason she always shown wearing gloves. Rai-chan, also helps her in many ways, not just being a unit, but a true companion to her, Rai-chan is also a sentient robot, Her companion can follow whenever Utaha is away and can remain stationary.
